hooks.name: Translation sync
hooks.description: When en.json changes, add any new or changed keys to es.json and pt.json.

action.prompt: src/lib/i18n/en.json was just saved. Sync translations: compare its keys with src/lib/i18n/es.json and src/lib/i18n/pt.json. For every key that is missing or whose English text changed, write a natural translation (Spanish for es.json, Brazilian Portuguese for pt.json) at a grade-6 reading level. Remove keys no longer in en.json. Preserve key order and {placeholders} exactly. Follow safety.md: result.* and card.* strings must not contain any word from src/lib/triage/bannedWords.json for that locale. Then run `node scripts/safety-lint.mjs` and fix anything it reports. Do not change en.json.
